description: Use this when the user asks whether a UAE TRN (tax registration number) looks valid or whether a business is registered for UAE e-invoicing on Peppol ("is TRN 100… valid?"). Checks that a UAE Tax Registration Number has the right format (15 digits; spaces and dashes are fine) and looks it up in the public Peppol Directory to see whether the business is registered for UAE e-invoicing. A valid format does not prove the TRN exists or is active: for that the user opens the TRN checker (link in the result), which asks the FTA register after the user types the FTA's security code. Do not use it to prove a TRN is active with the FTA: the result links the TRN checker, where the user sees the FTA register's answer.

trn.description: The TRN as the user wrote it.

name: check_trn
title: Check a UAE TRN
